Repair widens the already-wired settlement pipeline to settle every decision-identified ledger row; the existing wired 45-day catch-up then re-settles retrospectively with zero forward-vintage loss and no new manual materialization IDs.
notes: Defect class: semantic population-filter defect in the settlement pipeline (input-side canonical contract intact; no vendor bypass). Settlement is retrospective computation from the canonical hot warehouse, so the starved window was fully reconstructible with zero forward-vintage loss. Remaining honest blockers: settled_h20=0/30 matures ~2026-08-19+ by calendar; actual_cash_conflicts=0/10 is a rare-event bar worth a separate contract review if it stays 0 while decisions scale.
